name: ANCHOR research model v2
evaluation: Grouped held-out participant performance against stored labels; not a prospective evaluation.
intended_use: Technical research inference only against supplied unverified labels.
known_limitations: Exact target prediction origin, outcome window, endpoint convention, and complete follow-up are not verified.
Prediction-time availability and precise semantics of all input features are not verified.
Within-participant discrimination was near chance on the fixed v2 locked test.
The model is not calibrated and no decision threshold is approved.
